title: Angel of Fire
author: william-king
description: Lord Solar Macharius, greatest general of the Imperium since the Emperor's time, leads a vast crusade to reclaim a thousand lost worlds. Trooper Leo Lemuel and his companions follow Macharius from glory to glory, but every campaign leaves its scars — and the Lord Solar's crusade is just beginning.

title: Fist of Demetrius
author: william-king
description: Macharius pursues his crusade ever deeper into the uncharted east, hunting a sacred relic of a Space Marine Chapter lost in the pogroms of history. Alongside the Lord Solar's armies march Eldar, Dark Eldar raiders and stranger enemies still — and victory becomes ever more expensive.

title: Fall of Macharius
author: william-king
description: The Lord Solar's crusade falters. Exhausted, surrounded by enemies and undermined by those who fear his power, Macharius faces his final reckoning. The legend ends in the place all such legends must — in betrayal, in blood, and in a silence the Imperium will remember forever.
